title: smms weapons resource pack
description: Adds custom weapon textures and models, some of which are name based, model based, or enchantment based.
body:
A resource pack made for a server that I played on with some of my friends. Adds multiple custom textures and models accessed with either custom names or model data.

The dagger is made by naming a netherite sword "Sol Dagaa" (i did not come up with this name). The other netherite sword model is accessed when giving it the model data "goj" with commands. The really big stick is found by renaming a stick to one of multiple variations of "Really Big Stick". The brute breaker is accessed by naming a mace "Brute Breaker". The resin crusher can be seen by naming a golden axe "Resin Crusher". And finally, the bedrock breaker pickaxe can be seen if you put the bedrock breaker enchantment from neo enchant + on a diamond pickaxe.

Models and textures were made by me and my friends, and the pack was made by me. 

IMPORTANT NOTE: This is just a resource pack, and thus does not make the remodeled items have the stats that they had on our server. '

Also yes the version says 1.2, as there were two other versions before it, and no, I'm not changing that or sharing the other two versions.
